title: Orbital launch ascent
description:
Two-stage ascent to a ~150 km insertion point about 1,500 km downrange, with max-Q, MECO, staging and SECO events.

The scene is very wide and low, so the 3D view defaults to a stretched scale.

variants.label: Nominal
variants.notes: Mock ascent: flight-path angle falls from 90 to 2 deg; positions are launch-frame ENU (downrange, crossrange, up).

variants.label: Crosswind
variants.notes: Mock ascent: flight-path angle falls from 90 to 2 deg; positions are launch-frame ENU (downrange, crossrange, up).
